issue_context.title: disttask: remove reverting subtask
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Revert subtask is used for rollback task. It's created when the task failed or cancelled on each executor node of the task, and they have the same step as the current task step. It has the following issues:
- There's no rollback in any business type now, they are only used to notify us that we need cancel other pending/running subtasks which we can do without Revert subtask.
- Even though we DO need to rollback later, there's no need to create one subtask on each node.
- Node scale in/out, and those revert subtask are not balanced, so they will block the task. And even if they are balanced to active nodes, it's meaningless to run them there.

If rollback is required later, we can:
- Have a special step to do rollback.
- Rollback shouldn't be bind to some node. We can split the rollback into multiple subtasks though.

If we want to do some cleanup(such as cleanup local sorted kv) on each node, we should do it on subtask cleanup. Or start a background routine to do it if cleanup fails, or tidb exit abnormally.
